featured_reviews.name: Nelwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Royal orchid! 🍜🍷

Hands down, it's the best place in malwani/Marve area you can ever ask for.

This outlet is located in upper kharodi opposite to the tarana motor school. It takes about 20-25 min to get to this place from Malad station. The menu consist of wide variety of Indian, Koli, Chinese cuisine and even south Indian and pav bhaji if you fancy it.

The ambiance of the place has indoor seating with air conditioner which is well lit, beautiful and comfortable.

The staff of this place is very polite and will help you in suggesting if you're confused. The service is also great.

What I tried

Chicken Manchow soup

It was loaded with veggies and chicken pieces, flavored with soy sauce, vinegar, chili sauce and topped with fried noodles.

Black pepper chicken

The chicken was soft & juicy with some veggies and it tasted great!

Chicken crunchy garlic fried rice

Visually it looked good and it tasted great. The quantity was generous too.

Hot garlic Chicken gravy

This was one of the standout dish with full of flavour and soft diced chicken. You simply cannot ignore this delectable dish.

Chicken claypot rice

Clay pot rice is a unique dish which is cooked in a clay pot with rice,herbs, chicken & sauce. The taste of it was good but it was not served in a traditional clay pot.

Taste- 4.5/5

Ambiance- 4.5/5

Service- 4.5/5

This particular dine-out boasts dishes like Bun Maska Bruschetta, Murg Zafrani, Chicken Harissa Bao, Moroccan BBQ chicken pizza, Lasagna Al Polo & much much more!

We tried their Malai Chimichurri (chicken) for starters and Green Garlic Goblin noodles (prawns) as our mains. Both dishes, the portions were generous & the flavours were top-notch!
All in all Tessa gave us -- delectable food, the best service, and a perfect place to spend our Sunday night!
